biography.plain_text: Shahid “Shad” Khan is a Pakistani-born American industrialist who built his fortune in automotive manufacturing. After moving to Illinois as a teenager and studying engineering, he developed a one-piece truck bumper, founded Bumper Works and later bought his former employer, Flex-N-Gate, expanding it into a global supplier. He subsequently moved into sport as owner of the Jacksonville Jaguars and Fulham F.C., and as a backer of All Elite Wrestling.
